description: Returns the authenticated user's time-off requests for the current year — pending, approved, and rejected. Use when the user asks 'show me my time-off requests', 'what leave have I requested?', 'is my annual leave approved?'. Requires TimeOffManagement feature.
name: list_my_time_off

requests.description: Array of time-off request objects (id, leaveType, startDate, endDate, status, reason, totalDays)

title: My Time-Off Requests
